items.title: McDonald's names new US head as sales growth slows in Q2
items.summary: McDonald's posted second quarter earnings on Tuesday before the market opened, slightly missing the mark as consumers face a challenging economic backdrop.

items.title: Earnings live updates: Eli Lilly stock pops on upbeat guidance, Uber stock slides
items.summary: Earnings continue to be the market's engine, and a series of results this week from Palantir, SpaceX, and AMD are set to rev up stocks again.

items.title: Chipotle Stock Carries A Premium Built On New Restaurants
items.summary: Chipotle Mexican Grill stock is valued above the market on earnings while running a thinner margin, and the growth paying for that gap now comes mostly from opening restaurants.

items.title: McDonald’s Profit Beat Expectations. But Its CEO Is Still Unhappy With How Sales Grew: ‘We Simply Didn’t Execute’
items.summary: CEO Chris Kempczinski blamed inconsistent execution and a pullback in digital deals. The chain also named a new head of its US business.

items.title: The Poor Are Spending Less At McDonald’s
items.summary: Fast-food giants built their empires on budget-conscious customers, but a troubling shift in spending habits is forcing McDonald's to rethink who actually shows up at the counter.

items.title: McDonald's Stock Rises Despite Troubling U.S. Sales Miss
items.summary: McDonald's profit exceeded expectations, but weaker customer traffic exposed problems with its value promotions and digital offers.

items.title: McDonald’s net income increases 5% to $2.36bn in Q2 2026
items.summary: In the second quarter of 2026, the restaurant brand’s total revenue rose 4% to $7.09bn.
